Specification: A MultiPaxos consensus specification in state-machine replication style with write/read commands on a single key. Models replicas, ballot leadership, prepare/accept/commit message rounds via a monotonic message-set network, and observable client request/ack events. Liveness is checked by absence of deadlock until all requests are observed.
IfThenElse: IF \A pr \in prs: pr.votes[s].bal = 0 THEN "nil" ELSE LET bc == CHOOSE bc \in (Ballots \X Commands): /\ \E pr \in prs: /\ pr.votes[s].bal = bc[1] /\ pr.votes[s].cmd = bc[2] /\ \A pr \in prs: pr.votes[s].bal =< bc[1] IN bc[2]
IF (ReqEvent(c)) \notin Range(observed) THEN /\ observed' = Append(observed, (ReqEvent(c))) ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED observed
IF c \in Writes THEN c ELSE @
IF (AckEvent(c, v)) \notin Range(observed) THEN /\ observed' = Append(observed, (AckEvent(c, v))) ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED observed
IF ~terminated THEN ... ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"] /\ UNCHANGED << msgs, node, pending, observed >>
SetEnumeration: {AcceptMsg(self, node'[self].balPrepared, s, node'[self].insts[s].cmd): s \in {s \in Slots: node'[self].insts[s].status = "Accepting"}}
{AcceptMsg(self, node'[self].balPrepared, s, c), AcceptReplyMsg(self, node'[self].balPrepared, s)}
{m \in msgs: /\ m.type = "AcceptReply" /\ m.slot = s /\ m.bal = node[self].balPrepared}
FunctionConstructor: [s \in Slots |-> [node[self].insts[s] EXCEPT !.status = IF \/ @ = "Preparing" \/ /\ @ = "Empty" /\ PeakVotedCmd(prs, s) # "nil" THEN "Accepting" ELSE @, !.cmd = PeakVotedCmd(prs, s)]]
FunctionOverride: [node[self].insts[s] EXCEPT !.status = IF \/ @ = "Preparing" \/ /\ @ = "Empty" /\ PeakVotedCmd(prs, s) # "nil" THEN "Accepting" ELSE @, !.cmd = PeakVotedCmd(prs, s)]

[node EXCEPT ![self].leader = self, ![self].balPrepared = 0, ![self].balMaxKnown = b, ![self].insts = [s \in Slots |-> [node[self].insts[s] EXCEPT !.status = IF @ = "Accepting" THEN "Preparing" ELSE @]]]
[node EXCEPT ![self].leader = m.src, ![self].balMaxKnown = m.bal, ![self].insts = [s \in Slots |-> [node[self].insts[s] EXCEPT !.status = IF @ = "Accepting" THEN "Preparing" ELSE @]]]

[node EXCEPT ![self].balPrepared = node[self].balMaxKnown, ![self].insts = [s \in Slots |-> [node[self].insts[s] EXCEPT !.status = IF \/ @ = "Preparing" \/ /\ @ = "Empty" /\ PeakVotedCmd(prs, s) # "nil" THEN "Accepting" ELSE @, !.cmd = PeakVotedCmd(prs, s)]]]

[node EXCEPT ![self].leader = m.src, ![self].balMaxKnown = m.bal, ![self].insts[m.slot].status = "Accepting", ![self].insts[m.slot].cmd = m.cmd, ![self].insts[m.slot].voted.bal = m.bal, ![self].insts[m.slot].voted.cmd = m.cmd]
[node EXCEPT ![self].insts[s].status = "Committed", ![self].commitUpTo = s, ![self].kvalue = IF c \in Writes THEN c ELSE @]
RecordConstructor: [status: {"Empty"} \cup Statuses, cmd: {"nil"} \cup Commands, voted: [bal: {0} \cup Ballots, cmd: {"nil"} \cup Commands]]
[leader: {"none"} \cup Replicas, kvalue: {"nil"} \cup Writes, commitUpTo: {0} \cup Slots, balPrepared: {0} \cup Ballots, balMaxKnown: {0} \cup Ballots, insts: [Slots -> InstStates]]
[leader |-> "none", kvalue |-> "nil", commitUpTo |-> 0, balPrepared |-> 0, balMaxKnown |-> 0, insts |-> [s \in Slots |-> NullInst]]
[type: {"PrepareReply"}, src: Replicas, bal: Ballots, votes: InstsVotes]
[type |-> "PrepareReply", src |-> r, bal |-> b, votes |-> iv]
[type: {"Accept"}, src: Replicas, bal: Ballots, slot: Slots, cmd: Commands]

ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE s \in Slots: /\ insts[s].status = "Empty" /\ \A t \in 1..(s-1): insts[t].status # "Empty"
CHOOSE bc \in (Ballots \X Commands): /\ \E pr \in prs: /\ pr.votes[s].bal = bc[1] /\ pr.votes[s].cmd = bc[2] /\ \A pr \in prs: pr.votes[s].bal =< bc[1]
FunctionConstructor_ByDomain: [s \in Slots |-> [node[self].insts[s] EXCEPT !.status = IF \/ @ = "Preparing" \/ /\ @ = "Empty" /\ PeakVotedCmd(prs, s) # "nil" THEN "Accepting" ELSE @, !.cmd = PeakVotedCmd(prs, s)]]
DivisionNotes: ReplicasAssumption/WritesAssumption/ReadsAssumption/MaxBallotAssumption are predicate (boolean) operators used inside the anonymous ASSUME; they go in OperatorDefNames_StatePredicate.
terminated is a state predicate over pending/observed.
Spec and Termination are temporal property operators (use [] and <>).
rloop, Replica, Terminating, Next contain primed variables and go in ActionDefNames (excluded from the four operator partitions).
All other operators (typedefs, helpers, message constructors) are pure value definitions.
TemporalNesting is false: only [][Next]_vars and a single <>(\A...) appear; they are not nested inside each other.
